title: Claude Cowork and chat come together for Enterprise
summary: Claude Enterprise now offers one unified experience combining chat and Cowork across web, desktop, and mobile, and it is generally available. Chat tasks that need code or files move to an Anthropic-managed cloud environment where work continues after the laptop closes, with each agentic session isolated in its own VM and network egress off by default. Admins gain role access, model entitlements, spend limits, a new Efficient mode using Sonnet and Haiku, and pooled group budgets, while SSO and the Compliance API still apply and ZDR, HIPAA-ready, and CMEK orgs stay on their current setup.

title: IDC brings Quanta into Claude and adopts Claude across the company
summary: IDC's Quanta technology intelligence platform is now available as an MCP connector in Claude, letting users generate competitor briefs, vendor shortlists, and forecast comparisons with IDC source citations. It works in the Claude app, Cowork, and Microsoft Office add-ins and is available to IDC Quanta customers using Claude. IDC reports its internal rollout cut data repository rebuilds from about 3 months to 3 weeks and reduced code review from 5 days to about 30 minutes.

title: Expanding Claude for Nonprofits
summary: Claude for Nonprofits is a plugin of skills and connectors built with about 30 nonprofits, covering fundraising, marketing, hiring, board work, grant research, and responsible setup against AI policy. It extends through the Claude Corps fellowship with Taproot pro bono consulting, new consulting partners, and webinars, and it auto-installs at no extra cost on Team and Enterprise plans. Anthropic notes that 25,000+ nonprofits already use Claude, and more than 75% of them have under 10 seats.

title: Building agents: When to fold subagents into your main agent loop
summary: This guide explains when to replace multi-agent subagent setups with a single agent loop, moving domain procedures into on-demand skills and hard limits and lookups into tools. Shared context reduces lossy handoffs and can improve quality at lower cost and latency, with one customer reporting about 2x faster results. It recommends a small central team own the system prompt and evals, and migrating one subagent at a time against a small eval set while checking per-task results.

title: Introducing artifacts for legal work
summary: Ready-to-use interactive artifacts such as trackers and dashboards are now available for legal teams in a new legal gallery, with examples including a cite checker, matter board, and contract review. Partners contributing include Goodwin, Harvey, Foley & Lardner, and PwC, and 60+ legal connectors have been added since May. Artifacts can be shared with privacy and ethical-wall settings, and a Legal Ambassadors Program has launched with a waitlist open.

title: How to manage costs and demonstrate ROI for Claude Code on Google Cloud
summary: This best-practices guide covers controlling, tracking, and proving the value of Claude Code spend on Google Cloud. The Claude apps gateway in your Google Cloud project adds per-user, per-group, and per-org spend caps, model allowlists, in-CLI warnings at 75% and 95%, and an admin API, while Claude Code OpenTelemetry data now breaks down usage by skill, plugin, agent, and MCP server. The guide argues cost per task matters more than price per token and suggests pairing usage data with surveys and metrics like PR cycle time.
